biggest_catch: You must open BOTH a checking and a savings account simultaneously, and the $300 lands in your savings — not your checking — after two recurring direct deposits totaling $1,000+ within 90 days.
catches: Open a new checking account and savings account simultaneously using offer code GET500.
Make at least two recurring direct deposits totaling $1,000 or more to the checking account within 90 days of opening.
Bonus is deposited to the savings account (not checking), up to 30 days after the qualifying actions are completed.
First St. Mary's Bank checking account only; no primary or joint St. Mary's checking account in the prior 90 days.
Minimum $10 opening deposit for each account.
Accounts must be in good standing at payout.
The official page also advertises an optional $200 savings component with its own requirements.

steps: Go to the official checking page https://stmarysbank.com/for-you/bank/checking and open a new checking account and a new savings account simultaneously using offer code GET500.
Fund each account with the $10 minimum opening deposit.
Within 90 days of opening, have at least two recurring direct deposits totaling $1,000 or more deposited to the checking account.
Keep both accounts in good standing; the $300 bonus is deposited to the savings account up to 30 days after the qualifying actions are completed.
timing: Bonus deposited to the savings account up to 30 days after completing the qualifying actions.
